refund-policy.title: Refund policy
refund-policy.bodyHtml:
ZardoCards Return and Refund Policy
Last Updated: June 2025

Thank you for shopping at ZardoCards! We value your trust and are committed to providing you with authentic, high-quality Pokémon cards and merchandise.

1. No Returns Accepted

Due to the nature of our products and to maintain the integrity of our collectibles, all sales are final. We do not accept returns under any circumstances.

We encourage customers to review their orders carefully before completing a purchase. If you have any questions about a product, feel free to contact us before ordering — we're here to help.

2. Refunds

Refunds will only be issued in rare cases where an error occurs on our end, such as:

  • Receiving the wrong item

  • Receiving a damaged item (proof required)

If such a case arises, please reach out to us within 7 days of receiving your order. We’ll work with you to find a solution.

3. Non-Refundable Items

All products are considered non-returnable and non-refundable, except in the limited cases outlined above. This includes but is not limited to:

  • Opened or damaged booster packs or boxes

  • Sealed products that have been opened

  • Customized or altered items

4. Order Cancellations

Orders may be canceled within 24 hours of placement. After that period, if the order has been processed or shipped, it cannot be canceled or refunded.

5. Contact Us

If you believe you received an incorrect or damaged item, or have any concerns, please contact us through our Contact Us page. We're happy to assist and ensure your experience is positive.

6. Policy Updates

ZardoCards reserves the right to update this policy at any time. Please review it periodically to stay informed.

By shopping at ZardoCards, you agree to the terms outlined above.

shipping-policy.title: Shipping policy
shipping-policy.bodyHtml:
ZardoCards Shipping Policy
Last Updated: June 2025

Thank you for choosing ZardoCards! We're committed to delivering your order quickly, securely, and with care. Please read our shipping policy below for details on how we handle shipping and fulfillment.

Processing Time

  • All orders are typically processed and shipped within 24 hours on business days (Monday–Friday).

  • Orders placed on weekends or holidays will be shipped the next business day.

Shipping Locations

We ship worldwide from our warehouse in Canada.

Shipping Methods & Times

We offer a range of shipping options at checkout depending on your location. Average delivery times are:

  • Canada: 1–5 business days

  • USA: 1–7 business days

  • International: 3–14 business days

Please note: delivery times may vary due to customs, local postal services, or peak periods.

Shipping Rates

  • All rates are calculated at checkout based on your location and order size.

  • As of June 2025, we’ve reduced international shipping rates by 40% to make global access easier for all collectors.

Order Tracking

All orders come with tracking. You will receive a tracking number via email as soon as your order ships.

Lost or Delayed Packages

Once shipped, delivery is in the hands of the carrier. If your package is delayed or lost, please contact the shipping carrier directly using your tracking number.
We are not responsible for shipping delays, but we’ll do our best to support you if issues arise.

Customs & Import Duties

International customers are responsible for any applicable customs duties, VAT, or import fees charged by their country. These are not included in our shipping fees.

privacy-policy.title: Privacy policy
privacy-policy.bodyHtml:
ZardoCards Privacy Policy

Last Updated: June 2025

At ZardoCards, your privacy is important to us. This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, share, and protect your personal information when you visit our website or interact with our services. By using our site or services, you agree to the terms outlined below.

1. Information We Collect

We may collect the following types of information:

  • Personal Information: Your name, email address, shipping address, phone number, and payment details when placing an order.

  • Usage Data: Information such as IP address, browser type, pages visited, time spent on our site, and interaction logs.

  • Cookies & Tracking Technologies: We use cookies and similar technologies to enhance your user experience and understand your preferences.

  • Communication Data: Any information you share when contacting customer support or engaging with us via social media or other channels.

2. How We Use Your Information

We use your information to:

  • Process and fulfill your orders.

  • Provide customer support and manage transactions.

  • Personalize your experience, such as by recommending products.

  • Send you updates, promotional content, and newsletters (if you’ve opted in).

  • Improve our website, services, and customer experience based on feedback and analytics.

3. Sharing & Disclosure of Information

We may share your data in the following situations:

  • With Trusted Partners: Including payment processors, fulfillment centers, analytics providers, and marketing platforms, solely for business-related services.

  • Legal Requirements: If required to do so by law or in response to legal processes, to protect our legal rights, or to comply with governmental requests.

  • Business Transitions: In case of a merger, sale, or acquisition of all or part of our company.

4. Your Choices & Rights

  • Access or Modify Your Data: You can request to access, correct, or delete your personal information at any time by contacting us.

  • Opt-Out of Marketing: You can unsubscribe from our promotional emails via the unsubscribe link or by contacting us directly.

  • Manage Cookies: You can disable cookies through your browser settings, although some features of our site may not function properly.

5. Data Security

We implement industry-standard security protocols to safeguard your data. However, no online transmission or electronic storage method is completely secure. While we strive to protect your information, we cannot guarantee absolute security.

6. Children’s Privacy

Our services are not intended for children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from anyone under this age. If we discover such data has been collected, we will delete it promptly.

7. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy occasionally to reflect changes in our business, legal obligations, or service enhancements. When we do, we will revise the "Last Updated" date at the top of this page. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.

8. Contact Us

For any questions or concerns regarding this Privacy Policy or your personal data, please visit our Contact Us page or reach out to us directly through our support channels.

raw-cards-policy.title: Raw Cards & Sealed Policy
raw-cards-policy.bodyHtml:
We select card conditions fairly based on a thorough evaluation, ensuring transparency in each purchase. 


For raw cards the stated condition at the time of sale is final, and returns will not be accepted for condition-related concerns. This policy aims to provide a consistent, trusted experience for all buyers.
Condition Description
Mint Cards are in pristine condition with no visible flaws, scratches, or wear. They appear as though they were just taken out of the pack.
Near Mint Cards have minimal wear with very slight imperfections, such as a few faint scratches or very light edge wear. Almost new in appearance.
Lightly Played Cards show slight wear on edges and corners or very minimal surface imperfections. However, no significant damage is present.
Moderately Played Cards have moderate wear, visible scratches, and/or slightly frayed edges. They may have light surface wear but no heavy creases or bends.
Heavily Played Cards show heavy wear, including visible edge fraying, scratches, creases, and/or surface scuffing. May have multiple marks but are still structurally intact.
Damaged

Cards have substantial wear, with significant creases, bends, tears, or stains. These cards are strictly for collection and may not be suitable for tournament play or display.

 

For sealed products the stated condition at the time of sale is final, and returns will not be accepted for condition-related concerns. This policy aims to provide a consistent, trusted experience for all buyers.

Condition Description
Normal (1x) The product is in new or like-new condition with no rips, tears, or aesthetic damage to the packaging.
Imperfect (1x) The product is still complete, with all contents inside the box. The packaging may have aesthetic imperfections such as a torn box, ripped seal, or dents. The damage is to the exterior only and does not affect the product itself.
